# The Economic Times

> India's leading financial news platform providing real-time market data, investment analysis, and comprehensive business coverage.

The Economic Times is India's premier business and financial news organization, offering live market indices (Nifty 50, Sensex), stock analysis, IPO tracking, personal finance guidance, and industry news. The platform serves investors, entrepreneurs, and business professionals with real-time data, expert analysis, and educational resources.

## Key Topics

- Nifty 50
- BSE Sensex
- NSE (National Stock Exchange)
- Market Indices
- Live Market Data
- Stock Market Analysis
- Personal Finance
- Mutual Funds
- IPO Tracking
- Investment Analysis
- India Stock Exchange
- Real-time Updates
- Business News
- AI & Technology
- Startups & SMEs

## Live Market Data & Indices

- [Share Market Live Coverage](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/live-coverage): Real-time market dashboard with Nifty, Sensex, and technical analysis tools
- [Share Market Hub](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets): Central share market hub with live indices, news, and investment analysis
- [Nifty 50 Live Index](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/indices/nifty-50): Live Nifty 50 index tracking with real-time NSE data and market analysis
- [BSE Sensex Live Updates](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/indices/bse-sensex): BSE Sensex live updates with analysis and market sentiment tracking

## Investment Products & Analysis

- [ETPrime Exclusive Analysis](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/prime): ETPrime exclusive investment analysis and stock recommendations platform
- [Mutual Funds Reviews & Analysis](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mutual-funds): Mutual fund reviews, analysis, and recommendations for 2024 investments
- [IPO Tracking & Listings](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipo): Comprehensive IPO tracking with listings, subscriptions, and allotment details
- [Personal Finance & Wealth Management](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/personal-finance): Personal finance guidance on investments, banking, loans, and wealth management

## Business & Industry News

- [Breaking News & Live Updates](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news): Breaking news and live updates covering politics, economy, sports globally
- [Industry News & Analysis](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry): Industry news analysis covering pharma, energy, and market trends in India
- [Technology & AI News](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech): Tech news covering AI, startups, cybersecurity, and IT industry developments
- [SME & Startup News](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz): SME and startup news with entrepreneurship tips and business management advice
- [Live News Blogs](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/newsblogs): Live news blogs with breaking updates and current affairs from India globally

## Learning & Professional Development

- [ET Masterclass Courses](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/masterclass): Educational platform offering investing, finance, and AI courses by experts
- [Jobs & Career News](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/jobs): Employment news with career development advice and hiring policy updates

## Politics & Policy Coverage

- [Indian Politics News](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/politics): Indian politics coverage with cabinet reshuffles and regional developments

## Expert Opinion & Analysis

- [Opinions, Interviews & Debates](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/opinion): Expert opinions, interviews, editorials, and debates on economic topics

## Optional

- [NRI News & Immigration](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/nri): NRI news covering immigration, visas, and diaspora investment opportunities
- [ET Panache Lifestyle](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/panache): Lifestyle magazine covering entertainment, health, tech, and worklife balance
